text.description_html:
Fusion RH-F3, Tai Chi Robe Hook

The Tai Chi Trim Robe Hook is great for keeping things organized. Hang your bathrobe, purse, coat, hats, and even book-bag on this easy to install hook. It features bamboo designs along the mounts. It comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware. The Tai Chi Robe Hook has a rich medium bronze finish.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-F3 Tai Chi Towel Bar, Fusion TR-F3 Tai Chi Towel Ring, and Fusion PH-F3 Tai Chi Toilet Paper Holder

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Tai Chi Collection Robe Hook:

  • Finish: Medium Bronze
  • Mount Diameter: 2-3/4"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
